Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Kyle Mayers and Shai Hope will open the batting for India. Deepak Chahar will begin with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...
Right then! West Indies need 185 runs to win from 20 overs to win their first game of the tour. Will they chase this down? We will find out. Stay tuned!

Venkatesh Iyer is up for a quick chat. He says that more than his own batting, he enjoyed watching Suryakumar Yadav play all those shots and it was mesmerizing. He adds that Surya has a large range of shots and he can flick the ball behind square on both sides of the wicket. About his own flick shot, Iyer says that it was Surya's idea to get inside the line of the ball and play that shot.

A royal exhibition of batting by India! They would be mightily pleased after posting a target of 185! After losing Ruturaj Gaikwad early in the innings. Ishan Kishan and Shreyas Iyer steadied the ship and rebuit the innings. But they lost quick wickets in the middle. However, it was the fireworks by Suryakumar Yadav and Venkatesh Iyer who put together 91 runs and guided India to a total of over 180. At one point, 160 was looking tough. India have a good chance to clean sweep this T20I series as well! West Indies, on the other hand, started off well, added pressure on India early on, but they failed to capitalize on the same. They leaked over 80 runs in the last 5 overs and let the game slip away. They are well and truly capable of chasing this target down, however, this time, it's going to be a little tough since there is less dew on the ground.

An entertaining, exciting, thrilling first half of the game! It was raining boundaries at Eden Gardens! But, the story remains the same as the previous game. A good start from West Indies, but it's India who have done an exceptional job in the end with the bat. Another healthy total on the board, West Indies would be a disappointment here, it was the partnership of Iyer and Yadav that hurt them the most. West Indies face an uphill task ahead of them, but like the previous game, it is surely going to be an exciting chase.

OUT! TAKEN! The carnage has finally ended and Romario Shepherd does get a consolation wicket in the end. This is a full toss, on off stump. Suryakumar Yadav gets low and tries to whip it across once again. This time he doesn't quite middle it and the ball flies towards the square leg fence. Rovman Powell over there takes a good catch and a blistering knock from SKY ends. India finish with 184/5!
Commentary.Howout: c Rovman Powell b Romario Shepherd

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Back-to-back sixes and the half-century is up for Romario Shepherd with the ball! A rank half-volley, around off. Suryakumar Yadav hangs deep and lifts it high and handsome over the long off fence. 21 already off the over with one ball to go.

SIX! Suryakumar Yadav is playing shots never seen before. A full toss, angled across off. SKY with a whip across and those strong wrists come into play once again. The ball flies over the backward square leg fence for another biggie.

Full, on leg stump. Iyer looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg and they get a single. Romario Shepherd seems to be the only one appealing and the umpire turns him down.
Back of a length, on off. Yadav pulls it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! FIFTY! Suryakumar Yadav brings up the half-century in tremendous style. Full and wide, not quite full enough. SKY stays deep in his crease and goes inside-out, over the extra cover fence for another huge hit.
WIDE! An attempted slower ball, spilled well down the leg side. Wided.
Romario Shepherd will bowl the final over of the innings.

FOUR! Poor bowling this from Dominic Drakes. He is feeling the pressure. A juicy full toss, on middle. Venkatesh Iyer hangs back and powers it right back over the bowler's head for a boundary. 21 off the over and India well in the ascendancy at the moment.

FOUR LEG BYES! You've got to feel for the bowler! Even a perfectly executed ball goes for a boundary. Iyer shuffles right across his stumps, looking for the scoop shot but Drakes manages to fire it full and wide. The ball goes off the pads and runs away to the fine leg fence.

FOUR! Up and over! Full and wide, it's a good delivery but there are no fielders on the off side boundary behind point. Venkatesh Iyer goes hard at it and gets enough bat on it to slice it over point for a boundary.
On middle, this is pushed through mid on for a single.

SIX! That is skillful from Suryakumar Yadav! Full and wide, SKY sets up to go over extra cover but just throws his hands at it and opens the face of the blade ever so slightly. The pace of the ball carries it over the third man fence for a maximum.
Short and wide, slower in pace. Suryakumar Yadav hangs back and cuts it behind point for a couple. The 50-run partnership comes up between these two in almost double quick time.
Dominic Drakes comes to ball the penultimate over!
Dot to end the over! Full and wide again, it's a low full toss, dipping on the batter. Iyer looks to drive but is well beaten.

SIX! My word! A length ball, around middle and leg. Venkatesh Iyer shuffles across his stumps and gets inside the line of the ball. Iyer then lifts it all the way over the fine leg fence for a biggie.
Excellent again from the experienced Jason Holder! Full and wide, Iyer gives the charge but is nowhere near the pitch of the ball.
Well bowled! Full, angling on the pads and Yadav can only manage to get an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls away off the pads and onto the leg side. The batters sneak in a run though.
Length this time, angling down leg. Yadav tries to sway away from the line of the ball to let it through for another wide but doesn't manage to do so. Dot ball!
WIDE! Holder looks for the toe-crushing yorker yet again and misses the mark yet again as well. Down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
WIDE! That is a howler from Jason Holder. Holder tries to attack the pads but spills it well down the leg side, almost outside the pitch. Wided.
A bit of width on offer and this is slapped away to sweeper cover for a single.
Jason Holder (3-0-19-1) comes back to bowl his final over.
FOUR! A length ball, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav makes a bit of room and thumps it over extra cover for a boundary. 17 off the over, a good one for India.
Good-length, angled across off. This is driven on the up through covers for one.

SIX! BANG! Venkatesh Iyer was ready for the short ball and has dealt with it. Banged in halfway down the track and the ball sits up nicely for the batter. Iyer hangs deep in his crease and pulls it all the way, over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.

FOUR LEG BYES! Poor bowling but smart batting from Venkatesh Iyer. Iyer just moves a bit in his crease and Romario Shepherd tries to get the yorker in at the toes. He misses and Iyer gets a slight tickle off the pads. The ball runs away into the fine leg fence.
Only a single. Slower this time from Shepherd, full and angled in on the legs. Yadav flicks it down to deep mid-wicket for a run.
A length ball, on off. This is hit on the up and through cover-point for a run.
Romario Shepherd (2-0-16-0) comes back to the bowl.
Full and wide, this is driven nicely again but straight to deep cover for just a single.
FOUR! Another cover drive that is brilliantly timed! This is a half-volley, outside off. Iyer drives it uppishly into the cover fence.

Nicely bowled! A slower ball this time, on a good length and close to the off stump. Iyer waits for it and looks to runs it past backward point but gets beaten by the lack of pace and the extra bit of bounce as well.
WIDE! Full and wide, spilled beyond the tramline.
FOUR! Splendid timing! Pitched up, around off. Venkatesh Iyer with a superb cover-drive through the infield and the ball races away into the fence.
Uppish but in the gap! Slower length ball, outside off. SKY drives it through cover-point for a single.

SIX! What even is that shot? A length ball, angled across off. Suryakumar Yadav just plants his left leg across the off stump and scoops it way, way over the backward square leg fence. Nonchalant hit!
Shorter ball, angling it in, on the pads. Suryakumar Yadav clips it towards square leg for a single.
Quicker one, firing it on the sumps. Suryakumar Yadav looks to cut this away, but gets an under edge as the ball stays low.
Fuller ball, around middle. Venkatesh Iyer steps down and drills it towards long on for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav punches it towards deep cover for a single.

NOT OUT! Fraction shorter, angling it in on the pads. Venkatesh Iyer looks to flick this away, but he misses. The ball deflects off the pads and goes towards the third man region. A huge appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no. West Indies opt for the review. The replays roll, ad UltraEdge confirms a slight spike as the ball passes through the bat. The on-field decision stays and West Indies lose a review here! Also, a single is taken!

Kieron Pollard has gone for a late review for an LBW decision. The third umpire checks the replay and the ball seems close to the bat. UltraEdge confirms that there is a faint inside edge on it and the onfield decision will stand. Venkatesh Iyer survives as West Indies lose a review.
Shorter ball, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav cuts it towards cover for a single.
Fabian Allen comes on to bowl now.
Back of a length, outside off. Venkatesh Iyer stands tall and looks to drives it on the up, but misses. Good start for Dominic Drakes!
Venkatesh Iyer walks in at number 6.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Dominic Drakes strikes in his first over and he gets rid of the Indian skipper, Rohit Sharma! A length ball, on the leg stump. Rohit Sharma advances down the pitch and tries to go big over the leg side, but fails to get any connection. He misses the ball, which goes on to knock the stumps over. India lose their fourth wicket now.
Shorter ball, outside off. Rohit Sharma hangs back and looks to cut this away, but misses.
Length, around off. Suryakumar Yadav presents the full face of the bat, and taps it towards mid off for a quick single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rohit Sharma tries to get this one but gets an under edge towards point for a single.
On a length, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav looks to push this away but gets an inside edge towards fine leg. One run taken!
Dominic Drakes comes into the attack for the first time tonight.
Swing and a miss! Fuller this time, very quick again from Walsh, at 103 clicks. Rohit Sharma looks to sweep this one, but misses.
Short in length, outside off. Suryakumar Yadav looks to cut it away but gets an under edge towards cover for a single.
Outside off this time, tad fuller. Suryakumar Yadav pushes it towards the fielder at cover.
Short again, another quicker ball, outside off. Rohit Sharma pulls it to the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Shorter, and quicker, at 100.5 clicks. Suryakumar Yadav pulls it wide of long on for a single.
SIX! HIGH AND HANDSOME! A loopy ball, full, around middle and leg. Suryakumar Yadav waits for it and heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Fuller, flatter, outside off. Rohit Sharma looks to heave this away but misses.
Very full again, quicker, on middle. Suryakumar Yadav drills it to long on and rotates the strike.
Another fuller ball, around the off pole. Suryakumar Yadav nudges it towards mid-wicket. No run there!
Fuller ball, around middle. Rohit Sharma tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Quicker ball, flatter, around middle. Rohit Sharma pushes it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Loopy ball, fuller in length, on middle. Suryakumar Yadav knocks it to long on for a single.
Roston Chase to end his spell here. He has figures of 3-0-20-1 so far.
Fuller ball, outside off. Rohit Sharma taps it to cover. Dot to end the over!
Shorter ball, outside off this time. Suryakumar Yadav pushes it towards deep cover for a single.

SIX! PUNISHED! Hayden Walsh drops it short again, on middle. Suryakumar Yadav stays in his crease and slaps it towards cow corner for a bigger. Fabian Allen from deep mid-wicket runs and dives to his left, but fails to get there.
Shorter this time, around middle. Rohit Sharma, on back foot, knocks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Much slower through the air, full and on middle. Suryakumar Yadav eases it down to long off and rotates the strike.
A quicker ball, firing it on the pads. Rohit Sharma manages to tuck it away leg side off the inside edge for a single.
Quicker again, on off. Rohit Sharma works it off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single. At the halfway mark, India are 68/3!
This is slowed up and spilled down the leg side. Yadav clips it past square leg for a single.

Drinks! India were cruising along nicely after losing Ruturaj Gaikwad early in the innings. However, they have lost wickets in quick succession and have lost the momentum for now. West Indies have done to fight back, and take things under control now. They need to capitalize on the same from here. India still have their skipper Rohit Sharma at the crease, who would be hoping he stays till the end of the innings. Also, Suryakumar Yadav comes out to bat at number 5.

OUT! Cleaned up! Roston Chase's purple patch with the ball continues and both set batters are now back in the hut. Chase keeps coming from 'round the wicket to the left-hander and keeps angling the ball in. This is flatter and quicker, darted into off. Ishan Kishan gives himself room and looks to muscle the pull shot but the ball keeps a bit low. Kishan gets undone by the lack of bounce and the ball goes on to hit the top of off. India in a spot of bother here at the moment.
This is shorter again, on middle. Sharma keeps the scoreboard ticking over by just turning it through mid-wicket for a single.
shorter in length, at 100 clicks and angled into middle. Ishan Kishan hangs deep in his crease and pulls it in front of square for a run.
Darted in from 'round the wicket. Kishan defends it out.

Beaten! This is beautifully bowled by Walsh. On a nagging length, around off and the ball seems to turn away but holds its line. Rohit Sharma gets pushed on the back foot and gets beaten on the outside edge.
A bit slower through the air this time, around off. Sharma presses forward to defend it out.
This is well dragged down, outside off. Kishan pulls it down to long on for one.
Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India, comes to bat at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hayden Walsh has his man and India lose their second! This is a bit tossed up, quicker, and around off. Shreyas Iyer looks to lift this one over the long on fence, against the turn and that is his undoing. He goes too hard at it and the ball just turns away a bit. The ball skies up off the toe end of the bat, towards long off. Jason Holder keeps his eye on the ball and takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Holder b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter this time, over 100 clicks. Iyer is unable to get it away on the leg side.
The call is for two and they get it with ease. Fuller, on off. Iyer wrists it through mid-wicket and picks up a couple of runs.
Iyer winds up to play the big shot but Chase drops it shorter and quicker. Iyer flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short, around off. Kishan taps it through cover-point for a single. The 50 partnership is up between these two.
On a length, around off and there is a bit of turn on offer this time. Iyer just tucks it 'round the corner to turn the strike over to his partner.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! This is fired into off at a whopping 108 kph. Shreyas Iyer hangs back and heaves it into the vacant cow corner fence for another boundary.
This is floated up, on off. Kishan eases it down to long off and rotates the strike.
Quicker, around 95 clicks and skidding off the surface. Kishan looks to drive but gets it off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket. The batters do come back for the second as well.
Around off, this is punched through the cover region for a single.
FOUR! Nicely tossed up, on middle. This time Ishan Kishan clears the front leg and manages to drill it back past the bowler for a glorious boundary.
Shorter in length, on middle. Iyer turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
A bit slower and dragged down again. Kishan pulls it towards long on for a run.

Put down! That was very firmly hit but it certainly was a chance for such a great fielder like Hayden Walsh. Tossed up, on middle. Kishan makes a bit of room and thumps it right back at the bowler. Walsh's reaction is good but the ball just doesn't stick.
Walsh starts off with a quicker, flatter one, on middle. Iyer hops on the back foot and eases it through wide mid on for a single.
Hayden Walsh comes into the attack now.
Brilliantly bowled! A quick yorker fired in around the off pole. Iyer jams it out towards mid-wicket for one more.
A juicy full toss, outside off and dipping onto the batter. Kishan mistimes the drive straight towards the cover region. Just a single taken.
Quicker again, full this time and on off. Shreyas Iyer nudges it onto the on side with soft hands and picks up a quick single.
This is angled into middle and leg. Kishan hangs on the back foot and punches it through mid on for a single.
Quicker and flatter, around off. Kishan watches it all the way through and makes the block.
This is dragged down, well outside off. Ishan Kishan fetches it and sort of half-pulls it towards wide long on for a couple of runs.
Roston Chase is brought in to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
A shorter ball, outside off. Ishan Kishan taps it towards cover and takes a single. He retains the strike.
On a length, outside off. Ishan Kishan slashes it towards the fielder at cover-point.
Back of a length, outside off. Shreyas Iyer taps it towards point and scampers through to the other end.
An appeal for caught behind, but the umpire says no! A length ball, outside off. Shreyas Iyer looks to block this but gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries this time for Shreyas Iyer! Fuller again, width on offer. Shreyas Iyer slaps it past cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Glorious! A half-volley this time, around middle. Shreyas Iyer presents the full face of the bat and drives it straight down the ground for a beautiful boundary.
Jason Holder to bowl a third over on the trot. West Indies searching for another wicket in the Powerplay.
Back of a length, outside off. Ishan Kishan looks to cut this away, but misses it this time.
FOUR! Third boundary of the over! This is the Ishan Kishan we know! Shorter ball, outside off. Ishan Kishan stays back and slashes it past point for a boundary.
Shorter ball, outside off. Ishan Kishan taps it towards point.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Ishan Kishan! Fuller now, outside off. Ishan Kishan leans in and drives it past cover for another boundary.
FOUR! Top shot! Back of a length, outside off. Ishan Kishan advances down the track and slashes it over cover for a boundary.
Shepherd is also getting good shape on the ball. A good length ball, nipping back in from middle. Kishan keeps it out on the off side.
FOUR! WOW! Another player gets off the mark with a  boundary! Overpitched delivery, outside off. Shreyas Iyer lifts it over cover for a cracking boundary.
Just short of fist slip! Fuller ball, shaping away from outside off. Shreyas Iyer looks to drive but gets an outside edge, just short of the fielder at first slip.
Leg bye! Tad fuller, on the pads. Ishan Kishan misses his tuck. The ball deflects off his pads and goes fine leg. Leg bye taken!
Shreyas Iyer has been sent in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jason Holder strikes and draws first blood! Ruturaj Gaikwad walks back to the hut early in the innings! A length ball, nipping back in a tad, around middle. Ruturaj Gaikwad looks to flick this on the leg side but gets a thick outside edge towards third man. Kyle Mayers juggles a couple of times but holds on to it at the end. West Indies have an early breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Kyle Mayers b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around the pads. Ishan Kishan clips it towards fine leg for a single.

A stifled appeal for LBW from Jason Holder but the umpire is unmoved. A fuller ball, shaping back in, on the pads. Ishan Kishan misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. That was pitching outside leg.
Good-length delivery, shaping outside off. Ruturaj Gaikwad taps it towards the fielder at cover-point.
Very full now, outside off. Ruturaj Gaikwad guides it towards point.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off, shaping away late. Ruturaj Gaikwad steps down the pitch and swings his bat, but misses.
fuller now, on middle. Ruturaj Gaikwad defends it out solidly.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Ruturaj Gaikwad is up and running in stye too! Length, width on offer. Ruturaj Gaikwad stays back and slashes it past point for a boundary.
Top save! A shorter ball, outside off. Ruturaj Gaikwad stands tall and punches it towards cover. Fabian Allen at cover, dives to his right, and makes an amazing stop. Dot ball!
Romario Shepherd to share the new ball with Jason Holder.
Fuller now, around middle. Ishan Kishan drags it from the inner half of his bat towards mid-wicket. 5 runs off the first over!
On a length, around middle and leg, at around 128 clicks. Ishan Kishan defends it out.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Ishan Kishan gets off the mark in style! Tad shorter, around the thigh pads. Ishan Kishan stays in his crease and tucks it past square leg for a boundary.
Fuller length delivery, outside off this time. Ishan Kishan walks down and pushes it towards mid off. Dot ball!
On a length, around middle. Ishan Kishan blocks it out.

LEG BYE! Jason Holder begins with a fuller ball, darting it on the pads. Ruturaj Gaikwad misses his flick and gets rapped on the front pad. The ball rolls towards fine leg and the batters steal a leg bye!

We are ready for play! Ajit Agarkar rings the bell to signal the start of the match and the Indian openers, Ruturaj Gaikwad and Ishan Kishan take guard. Jason Holder has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. But before that, the West Indies players take the knee as the Indian players have their hands on their badge to show their support for the BLM movement. All set now. Let's go...

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India, says that they batted first last time as well and did well so they are ready for the challenge tonight but they have a different batting lineup tonight. Informs that they have made four changes with Kohli, Pant, Bhuvi and Chahal making way for Ruturaj, Shreyas, Shardul, and Avesh Khan to make his debut. Rohit also mentions that tonight Ishan and Ruturaj will open the innings. He mentions that it is a good test of their physical and mental strength and hopes that they come out on top yet again.

Kieron Pollard, the skipper of West Indies, says that they are going to bowl first, and nothing much has changed for them since the last few games. Informs us that they have four changes, Walsh, Fabian, Drakes, and Hope come in. Mentions that they have done well with the bat in the previous games but they have to improve their fielding and bowl better at the death. States that it is an opportunity for all the young guys to get try these conditions and for them to see what they offer.

India (Playing XI) - Ruturaj Gaikwad (In for Rishabh Pant), Ishan Kishan (WK), Rohit Sharma (C), Shreyas Iyer (In for Virat Kohli), Suryakumar Yadav, Venkatesh Iyer, Shardul Thakur (In for Yuzvendra Chahal), Deepak Chahar, Harshal Patel, Ravi Bishnoi, Avesh Khan (On debut) (In for Bhuvneshwar Kumar).

West Indies (Playing XI) - Kyle Mayers, Nicholas Pooran, Rovman Powell, Kieron Pollard (C), Roston Chase, Fabian Allen (In for Sheldon Cottrell), Romario Shepherd, Hayden Walsh (In for Akeal Hosein), Dominic Drakes (In for Odean Smith), Shai Hope (WK) (In for Brandon King), Jason Holder.
TOSS - West Indies have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

PITCH REPORT - Deepdas Gupta is alongside Ajit Agarkar for the Pitch Report. DDS says that the pitch is the same as the one used in the second T20I. Ajit adds that even though it's the second game on the same track, it should be a high-scoring game yet again. There are a few patches but the bowlers will find it difficult. DDS mentions that dew might be a factor but the conditions have been overcast all day long and that might mean that there's less dew tonight.
Some exciting news! Avesh Khan has just received his T20I cap and he is all set to make his senior international debut for India..

West Indies came really close to getting their first win of the tour last time around but the blitz from Nicholas Pooran and Rovman Powell just wasn't enough. Their openers have failed throughout the tour and with almost nothing to play for, the visitors might also tweak their playing XI. One man who certainly deserves to keep his place in the playing XI is Roston Chase. He was given a chance in the first T20I as Holder was injured but Chase has turned out to be their best bowler. So, will the hosts make a double clean sweep? Or will the T20I Kings end the tour on a high? We'll find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

India have already taken an unassailable lead in the 3-match series and with Virat Kohli and the vice-captain Rishabh Pant being released from the bio bubble, a lot of changes are expected tonight to the playing XI. Avesh Khan, who has been sitting on the sidelines might get his international debut. Shreyas Iyer might also come in for one of the two players released from the bio bubble and get a game at his new franchise's home ground. This match will help the hosts to utilize the bench strength as well.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 3rd T20I between India and West Indies. This is the final match of the T20I series and also of the tour. The hosts will be looking to repeat the clean sweep that they achieved during the ODI series here as well. The visitors will be looking to round off a disappointing tour with a consolation victory.
... MATCH DAY ...
